description: This file defines the 'Statistics' model class within the Opencart admin reporting module. It provides methods for retrieving, adding, removing, and editing statistical data stored in the database.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Model class for handling statistical data in the OpenCart admin report module. Extends the engine model class to interact with the database for CRUD operations related to statistics.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistics from the database table 'statistics'. Returns an array of rows.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific statistic identified by the $code parameter. Returns a float value or 0 if not found.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increases the value of a specific statistic by the given amount.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decreases the value of a specific statistic by the given amount.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific statistic to the provided value.
